**Dear Colleague,**

I am writing to provide a comprehensive overview Joshua Wood's current medical status, following his consultation on May 22, 2026.

**History and Examination:**

Mr. Wood, a 79-year-old male, presented for a medication refill. He reports feeling well overall but has had some recent dermatological concerns.

**Medical Conditions:**

**Prostate Cancer:** Mr. Wood has a history of prostate cancer, Gleason score 7, diagnosed in November 2009. He underwent surgical treatment approximately 15.3 years ago. Currently, his cancer is controlled with an undetectable PSA. No additional medications are being used for this condition.

**Eczema:** Mr. Wood has controlled eczema, which started in Z024. He is currently managing this with triamcinolone topical 0.1%.

**Acne:** His acne, which began in August 2021, is also well-controlled. Treatment includes minocycline 100 mg and doxycycline 100 mg.

**Erectile Dysfunction:** Erectile dysfunction, onset April 2024, is currently controlled with tadalafil 5 mg.

**Rosacea:** Rosacea, which appeared in September 2024, is managed with metronidazole topical 1% and ivermectin topical 1%.

**Vital Signs and Physical Examination:**

At the time of consultation, Mr. Wood’s blood pressure was 142/91 mmHg, and his weight was 143 lbs. A brief physical examination revealed no acute distress. Cardiovascular and respiratory examinations were unremarkable. Dermatologically, there were no active lesions, and skin turgor was normal. The remainder of the physical exam was within normal limits.

**Social History:**

Mr. Wood is a former smoker, having quit in June 2024, after smoking approximately 1.5 packs per day since October 2001. He reports consuming around one alcoholic drink per week. His family history includes a mother who had a myocardial infarction at age 46 and passed away at 57, and a living father diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease at age 73.

**Impression and Recommendations:**

Mr. Wood’s conditions are all currently controlled with the listed medications. He should continue these treatments as prescribed. Regular follow-ups for his dermatological conditions are recommended to monitor for any exacerbations. Additionally, he should maintain regular check-ups for his prostate cancer surveillance.

Thank you for referring Mr. Wood to our care. Please feel free to reach out if there are any further questions or if additional information is needed.

Yours sincerely,

**Dr. Amy Gray** 
Family Medicine Specialist 
Vaughn-Washington Clinic
